rationale: B1 (frozen encoder + trainable head) lowers FAR (0.271 -> 0.104) but RAISES FRR on expert-correct child phones (0.227 -> 0.299). FRR-first: rejecting more human-correct speech is a regression, so a FAR gain does not count as an improvement. B1 regresses FRR on every age band and on the majority of frequent phones, and it also lowers confidence on adult-TTS controls (no domain gain).
